description: This Java test class verifies the behavior and integrity of the StreamAck class, including immutability, equality, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: StreamAckTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various aspects of the StreamAck class, including immutability, equality, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the StreamAck class is immutable.

methods.name: equalsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of StreamAck work as expected.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Tests the creation of a successful StreamAck and verifies its element ID and status.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Tests the creation of a failed StreamAck and verifies its element ID and status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes a StreamAck to JSON, deserializes it back, and verifies the object remains equal to the original.
